principle: Question bank + pattern->registry map for DISTILLING Kaggle notebooks into candidate registry ENTRIES (the LLM population of #88 + the registries it feeds). Each notebook is investigated via the LLM lane (Kimi/GLM/Claude over the ollama gateway, OH_LLM_API_KEY); the deterministic FLOOR maps detected patterns -> candidate entries when no lane. LOSSLESS DISTILLATION CLAUSE: distillation is NEVER replacement — keep the raw kernel + patterns + LLM output + lineage. serves_truth=false (a distilled insight is a CANDIDATE; verify + promotion boundary before adoption).

questions.prompt: What is the core end-to-end pipeline (data -> model -> output)? List the stages in order.
What single technique most drives this notebook's score/lift, and why does it work?
What here is reusable as a governed COMPONENT (a tool/step) vs competition-specific glue?
What prompting pattern (CoT / few-shot / constrained / chat-template)?
What is NOVEL vs standard practice? What would a strong baseline miss?
Does this suggest a NEW registry or a new ENTRY in an existing one? Which registry, and what shape?
